mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_monitoring_data (user_id, device_id, data_type, data_value, data_unit, systolic, diastolic, measurement_time, is_abnormal, abnormal_level, notes) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{dataType}, #{dataValue}, #{dataUnit}, #{systolic}, #{diastolic}, #{measurementTime}, #{isAbnormal}, #{abnormalLevel}, #{notes})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM health_monitoring_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY measurement_time DESC
SELECT data_type AS dataType, COUNT(*) AS count, AVG(data_value) AS avgValue FROM health_monitoring_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY data_type

SELECT DATE(measurement_time) AS date, data_type AS dataType, AVG(data_value) AS avgValue, COUNT(*) AS count FROM health_monitoring_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND measurement_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(measurement_time), data_type ORDER BY date DESC
